roles.label: INA228 SDA
roles.needs: Any free or caution pin: the own I2C master routes SDA through the GPIO matrix to any pad below GPIO49.

roles.label: INA228 SCL
roles.needs: Any free or caution pin: the own I2C master routes SCL through the GPIO matrix to any pad below GPIO49.

roles.label: INA228 ALERT
roles.needs: A free pin below GPIO32: the ALERT handler reads one interrupt status register, GPIO_STATUS_REG, which latches GPIO0 to GPIO31 only.

roles.label: Relay 1
roles.needs: Any free or caution pin: the relay bank drives its input as a plain output.

roles.label: Relay 2
roles.needs: Any free or caution pin: the relay bank drives its input as a plain output.

defaults.source: hardware/rig.kicad_sch rev D; docs/rig-wiring.md; firmware/src/pinmap.h kDefaultMap

none.sentence: Nothing on the chip or the board claims it.

power.sentence: A supply terminal, not a GPIO.

reset.sentence: The chip's enable line, not a GPIO: pulling it low reboots the board.

strapping.sentence: A strapping pin: its level at reset selects the boot mode, the JTAG source or the VDD_SPI voltage.
strapping.source: ESP-IDF, GPIO & RTC GPIO (ESP32-S3): "GPIO0, GPIO3, GPIO45 and GPIO46 are strapping pins"

memory.sentence: A line of the in-package SPI flash or of the octal PSRAM.
memory.source: ESP-IDF, GPIO & RTC GPIO (ESP32-S3): GPIO26 to GPIO32 flash and PSRAM, GPIO33 to GPIO37 octal PSRAM; the ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 guide: GPIO35 to GPIO37 "not available for external use"

usb.sentence: The native USB pair, used by USB-Serial-JTAG by default.
usb.source: ESP-IDF, GPIO & RTC GPIO (ESP32-S3): "GPIO19 and GPIO20 are used by USB-JTAG by default"

uart0.sentence: UART0, wired to the CH343P bridge: the console, which recovery needs.

led.sentence: A status-LED line: the firmware blanks it at boot and holds it low.

jtag.sentence: A JTAG pad: usable, but taking it costs an external JTAG probe.
jtag.source: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 v1.1 guide, J3 rows (MTCK, MTDO, MTDI, MTMS)

vdd_spi.sentence: In the VDD_SPI power domain: 3.3 V on this S3-N16R8 module, 1.8 V on an R8V part.

rows.hover: 3.3 V, the output of the on-board 1117C 33 LDO; it powers the INA228 breakout and Relay 2's module.
